name: Subsea gas compression
principle: Compressors on the seabed boost gas to the platform, replacing topside compression. Equinor's Åsgard system, in about 300 m of water with a 40 km pipeline to Åsgard B, raised recovery on Midgard from 67% to 87% and on Mikkel from 59% to 84%, adding 306 million boe for just above NOK 19 billion.

source.note: Equinor, The first subsea gas compression plant in the world on line, 17 September 2015
